thread:
incident-bot: Pager: inference-queue-backlog HIGH (targets: production).*auto-escalate*

oncall-amber: picking up the pager — joining bridge now.

oncall-amber: bridge: https://meet.redwood.example/incident/2169504321 :wave:

sre-ryan: seeing a rapid increase in queued requests to gpu-pool-eu-1, autoscaler not spawning new pods. CPU on control-plane is fine but scale-up events failing.

infra-zoe: checked cluster events — API server 429s to cloud provider during the spike. provider rate limits hit for instance creation.

eng-latency: logs from router show ~20% 503s for long-polling requests. sample: `2026-03-15T13:04:12Z GET /v1/generate 503 backend overloaded`

support-maya: support tickets trickling in, customer-visible errors for some long tail requests — severity P2 for now.

oncall-amber: initial mitigation plan: 1) throttle non-essential routes (embeddings-batch) 2) enable fallback routing to gpuhot-alt (smaller model) 3) request manual capacity from cloud portal if possible.

sre-ryan: started throttling embeddings-batch via rate-limit config: `rbac:route:embeddings-batch:limit=50/s` — applying now.

infra-zoe: provider support responding; they can temporarily bump quota for instance group but needs 12-15m to provision. Request ticket #CLOUD-78921 opened.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rolling config change applied by sre-ryan (change-id: cfg-98321) — routing rules updated.

eng-latency: enabling fallback: updating routing policy to send <10% of traffic to small-quantized model as a canary. patch: `route.fallback = true`

support-maya: noted in ticket pipeline: customers A,B,C impacted (partial), we've issued status page update: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2169504321 :white_check_mark:

product-oliver: add note to customers: expected degraded throughput for ~30m while we drain queues. Keep the status page updated.

oncall-amber: handing off to sre-ryan at 13:25 UTC for remediation and postmortem. Amber stays in loop but stepping away for oncall rotation.

sre-ryan: taking over. current state: queue depth reduced ~60% after throttles and fallback; backend error rate still above baseline. manual scale requested, ETA ~14m.

infra-zoe: cloud replied with temporary quota increase — provisioning some nodes now. Will post when nodes join.

sre-ryan: started controlled drain: moving high-latency lanes to fallback model. Command used: `redwood route shift --from=embeddings-batch --to=fallback-small --percent=70`

support-maya: customers notified update sent at 13:31 UTC. No escalations to SEV1.

incident-bot: Node join event: 3 instances added to gpu-pool-eu-1 at 13:40 UTC.

eng-latency: after nodes joined, autoscaler metrics look healthy, queue drain continuing. Error rate trending down to normal over 6m.

sre-ryan: marking mitigation complete at 13:48 UTC — removing emergency throttles and stepping down fallback to baseline canary (5%).

oncall-amber: quick impact summary for post-incident note: affected region EU, partial throughput degradation for ~44 minutes, ~20% of requests experienced 503/short-failures, small set of customers saw increased latency and retries. No data loss.

product-oliver: schedule postmortem meeting — propose 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC. Will invite SRE, Infra, Eng Runtime, Support.

sre-ryan: creating postmortem doc and JIRA: PM-3482. Draft of timeline + logs will be attached.

infra-zoe: action items from bridge:
- AI1: investigate provider quota throttle patterns and implement pre-warming (owner: infra-zoe, due: 2026-03-24)
- AI2: add control-plane retry/backoff for instance create to reduce 429 impact (owner: sre-ryan, due: 2026-03-22)
- AI3: improve routing automations to cut non-critical routes faster (owner: eng-latency, due: 2026-03-19)
- AI4: run a DR drill for regional failover with reduced quota (owner: product-oliver, due: 2026-04-01)

support-maya: logging follow-up: attach sample request IDs for customers to PM-3482 and notify SEs.

sre-ryan: creating an interim dashboard alert: `inference.queue.depth > 1000 for 5m => page oncall` so we can get earlier detection.

incident-bot: Followup Task created: PM-3482 (postmortem) assigned to sre-ryan.

oncall-amber: closing bridge — leaving notes in the postmortem doc. Thanks all for quick remediation. :thumbsup:

sre-ryan: closing thread, will update PM-3482 with final timeline and remediation status.

product-oliver: quick add — consider adding a fallback model placement in another region for critical routes (discussion item for postmortem).
